cards.meaning: noisy, petty squabbling; bickering (often repeated, neither side backing down)
cards.example: Sawang-sawa na ang mga tao sa bangayan ng mga pulitiko habang tumataas ang presyo ng bilihin.
cards.exampleMeaning: People are fed up with politicians' bickering while prices keep rising.
cards.note: Pang-araw-araw at medyo mapanghamak: ipinapahiwatig na walang saysay ang away. Bagay sa pulitika at sa magkapatid. Iba sa 'alitan' (seryoso, may ugat). 'Ang bangayan ay ingay, ang alitan ay ugat.'
cards.tiesTo: Ejercito: political noise not helping investment; Senate pauses Sara Duterte trial for 2027 budget

cards.meaning: dispute, conflict (serious, often long-running; formal/news register)
cards.example: Nananatiling bukas ang alitan sa West Philippine Sea dahil hindi pa natatapos ang Code of Conduct.
cards.exampleMeaning: The dispute in the West Philippine Sea remains open because the Code of Conduct is still unfinished.
cards.note: Pormal; ginagamit sa balita at diplomasya ('alitan sa teritoryo'). Hindi sasabihing 'bangayan sa West Philippine Sea' — magiging away-bata ang seryosong usapin. Puwedeng tahimik at tumagal nang dekada.
cards.tiesTo: ASEAN-China summit: South China Sea Code of Conduct deadline missed

cards.meaning: as far as X is concerned; in terms of X (frames an analytical topic)
cards.example: 就消费而言，十月的零售额只增长了0.4%。
cards.examplePinyin: Jiù xiāofèi ér yán, shíyuè de língshòu'é zhǐ zēngzhǎngle bǎi fēn zhī líng diǎn sì.
cards.exampleMeaning: As far as consumption is concerned, October retail sales grew just 0.4%.
cards.note: 书面语(统计公报、研报、评论)。搭配:就+名词(消费/价格/规模/长期)+而言。近义:对……来说 更口语,多指某人的立场('对我来说');就……而言 客观、分析性。
cards.tiesTo: China October activity data: retail sales +0.4%

cards.meaning: to drag down; to weigh on (a burden holding something back)
cards.example: 房地产拖累了经济增长。
cards.exampleMeaning: Real estate dragged down economic growth.
cards.note: 新闻/书面语。搭配:A拖累B;被动'受……拖累'(受出口下滑拖累)。近义:导致 中性因果;拖累 强调负担、本该前进却被拉住。
cards.tiesTo: China property investment -21.6% Jan-Oct drags economy
